name: intentset
description: Intentset: product intent, behavior, implementation, verification and knowledge, connected in readable files. Reference implementation of the v0.1 specifications.

scripts.build: rm -rf packages/*/dist && node --conditions=intentset-source packages/conformance-suite/stage.ts && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/markset-adapter/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/architecture/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/verification/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/publisher/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/atlas/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/conformance-suite/tsconfig.build.json
